  • Flow of treatment
  • Side effects and downtime of medical hair removal
  • Those who cannot receive hair loss treatment
  • Cost of hair removal treatment performed at our hospital

Do you have any problems like this?

  • I'm embarrassed to wear light clothes or swimsuits
  • My hair is thick and cannot be cleaned by self-treatment.
  • My skin got rough when I was trimming my hair with a razor.
  • It takes time to shave by yourself every time.
  • I want to remove hair but it seems painful
  • I didn't feel any effect at the hair removal salon.

Features of “Lightshare Duet” used at our hospital

Large irradiation port allows for short treatment times

Equipped with a large, planar irradiation port, Light Shear Duet is able to irradiate and remove hair more efficiently and in a shorter time than conventional hair removal devices.
Furthermore, since the suction system reduces pain, there is no need to apply gel before the procedure or cool it down after the procedure, reducing the time spent at the clinic.

Suction system makes it difficult to feel pain

Since the skin is suctioned and stretched before being irradiated, efficient hair removal is possible and pain is reduced. Also, high effectiveness can be achieved with low output.

Compatible with various skin types with two handpieces

The LightSheer Duet is equipped with two types of handpieces.

HighSpeed (HS) handpiece ChillTIP (ET) handpiece
part Can be used over a wide range of the whole body Small areas such as the face, fingers and toes
hand piece suction type cooling type
Features
  • Equipped with a large irradiation port, it is possible to irradiate a wide range in a short time.
  • Irradiation is performed while suctioning, which greatly reduces pain.
  • Since irradiation is performed while cooling, hair removal can be done while protecting the skin.
pain There is almost no pain, just a warm, gentle stimulation. mild tingling pain

*Scroll horizontally to view the entire page

Flow of treatment

1counseling

Staff or a doctor will provide counseling. We will ask you about your concerns about unwanted hair and the areas you would like to have hair removed.

2medical examination

We will examine the skin condition and hair quality of the desired area to determine whether hair removal using Light Shear Duet is possible.
We will also explain side effects, risks, downtime, precautions, etc.

3irradiation

We use Light Shear Duet to carefully irradiate the area.

4Go home

After checking the condition of your skin and hair removal, you can go home.

Side effects and downtime of medical hair removal

Side effects/risks

  • Redness, warmth, itching, pain, and dryness may occur, but this usually subsides within two weeks.
  • In rare cases, worsening of bruises, comedones, folliculitis, and pigmentation may occur.

Downtime and precautions

Treatment time: Approximately 10 to 40 minutes (10 minutes for both armpits, 30 minutes for both elbows, 40 minutes for VIO)
Downtime: Almost no *There are individual differences

  • If redness, warmth, itching, pain, or dryness occurs, there will be downtime of 1 to 2 weeks.
  • On the day of the treatment, your skin will have a very slight burn. Avoid bathing and keep yourself in the shower.
  • Please refrain from excessive drinking and strenuous exercise on the day of your treatment.
  • For a while from the day of your treatment, please take care to moisturize your skin more carefully than usual.
  • After your treatment, please take as much protection from UV rays as possible by wearing sunscreen, a hat, and a parasol.

  • Please shave the treatment area as much as possible beforehand.
    If you wish to have extensive treatment done here, there will be a separate shaving fee of ¥1,000I will receive it.

  • We do not remove hair from the entire body in one treatment.

Those who cannot receive hair loss treatment

After checking your skin condition, chronic disease, medical history, presence of allergies, medications you are currently taking, presence of pregnancy, etc., your doctor may decide to deny you treatment.
Please contact us for more details.

Cost of hair removal treatment performed at our hospital

*30% discount will be applied from the 4th time onwards, and 50% discount will be applied from the 10th time onward.
